_purpose: Tracked fixture for the secret-hygiene legs. Every value below is SYNTHETIC, written by hand for this fixture: it is not an operational credential and never was. The fixture exists so the legs prove the same harvest rule (key-name markers + length floor) in ANY checkout of the exact SHA, instead of depending on an untracked credential store outside the repository (DEF-TEST-CHECKOUT-COUPLING).
_negative_controls: notes_bundle_path carries a long value under a NON-marker key and must NOT be harvested; deployment_token_short carries a marker key but a value below the length floor and must NOT be harvested. If either ever is harvested, the rule was widened and these legs stop meaning what they say.
